mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns despite a decline in UNRATE, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which can lead to decreased borrowing and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a growing economy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns despite the specified GDP and CPI movements, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite a rising UNRATE in a late-cycle expansion, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong supply activity, which positively impacts economic growth and leads to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns despite an increase in INDPRO, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates reduced demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative economic growth and lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite a decline in HOUST, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong but unemployment (UNRATE) rises, it indicates potential imbalances in the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite the specified GDP and UNRATE movements, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: During an early-cycle recovery, an increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns despite an increase in RSAFS, this hypothesis is falsified.
